title: OCI映像索引：平台描述與不可變主體鏈
titleEn: OCI image indexes: platform descriptors and immutable subject chains
subcategoryTitle: 軟體來源證明與透明度
summary: 建立10個部署描述，列要求OS、architecture、variant、索引摘要與實際選中manifest；另列未知平台與重複匹配順序反例。
summaryEn: Build ten deployment descriptors with required OS, architecture, variant, index digest and selected manifest. Include unsupported platforms and multiple matching entries, retaining their order rather than treating the index as an unordered dictionary.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

optionsEn: A wrong deployment may arise from platform selection or a tag resolving differently between verification and execution. Compare both immutable index and child-manifest identities to distinguish the two failure paths.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: OCI映像索引把多平台manifest連在一起；本課驗證索引摘要、平台選擇與子manifest摘要，避免將同一tag當成所有裝置上相同的二進位內容。
knowledge.textEn: An OCI image index connects manifests for multiple platforms. Verify index digest, platform selection and child-manifest digest, avoiding the assumption that an equal tag means every device executes identical bytes or that an index signature alone selects the intended platform.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立10個部署描述，列要求OS、architecture、variant、索引摘要與實際選中manifest；另列未知平台與重複匹配順序反例。
knowledge.textEn: Build ten deployment descriptors with required OS, architecture, variant, index digest and selected manifest. Include unsupported platforms and multiple matching entries, retaining their order rather than treating the index as an unordered dictionary.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本地准入要求平台契約符合且選中manifest摘要在已審查集合；tag只做顯示，不當穩定識別。索引摘要與子摘要各有不同範圍，不能互相代換。
knowledge.textEn: The local gate requires platform compatibility and a selected manifest digest in the reviewed set. Tags remain display labels. Index and child-manifest digests identify different objects and cannot be substituted for one another in verification.
